title: A question bank
description: One track's questions. Ids share one space across both banks: the individual bank uses 121-210 and the team bank 301-390, and a collision halts the loader rather than overwriting.

element.description: Open value, not an enumeration (spec 7.1a). Element identity is the pair (track, element): the team bank has a condition called Learning which is the old Improvement Loop, not the CLOVER element of the same name.
